highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform support, native packaging, rendering synchronization, and managed memory efficiency.
highlights_body: Apple deployment targets have moved forward, WebGPU support is bundled more reliably, and several managed and HarfBuzz paths now reduce unnecessary allocations or retained data.

bullets.detail: Updates the minimum supported Apple platform versions for the current runtime and tooling baseline.

bullets.lead: WebGPU native support packaged with SkiaSharp
bullets.detail: Includes emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so consumers using the WebGPU backend receive the required native implementation.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering synchronized to display refresh
bullets.detail: Coordinates texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother Android presentation.

bullets.lead: Bundled HarfBuzz functions bound locally on Linux
bullets.detail: Resolves HarfBuzz entry points from the bundled library on Linux, keeping text-shaping support self-contained.

bullets.lead: Managed pixel copies made more efficient
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed image pixel-copy paths to reduce overhead when transferring pixel data.
Reuses UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids unnecessary native feature-string allocation while preserving shaping and decoding behavior.
Corrects front-buffered stream retention so data is not kept longer than necessary.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Made bundled HarfBuzz function resolution self-contained on Linux and improved browser sample test readiness
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Packaged the WebGPU implementation inside the native SkiaSharp library
